valid.title: The link is open
valid.body: {sender} sent you this link. It shows only what it was made for.
valid.bodyAnonymous: This link shows only what it was made for.

used.title: This link was already used
used.body: It cannot be used again. If you need it once more, ask {sender} for a new link.
used.bodyAnonymous: It cannot be used again. If you need it once more, ask whoever sent it to you for a new link.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Ask {sender} to send you a new one.
expired.bodyAnonymous: Ask whoever sent it to you for a new one.

wrong_person.title: This link was sent to someone else
wrong_person.body: The name or address you gave does not match the person it was sent to. Ask {sender} to send a link to you.
wrong_person.bodyAnonymous: The name or address you gave does not match the person it was sent to. Ask whoever sent it to send a link to you.

withdrawn.title: This link was withdrawn
withdrawn.body: {sender} withdrew it. Ask them for a new one if you still need it.
withdrawn.bodyAnonymous: It was withdrawn. If you still need it, ask whoever sent it to you for a new one.

unavailable.title: This link can no longer be opened
unavailable.body: It may have been used, have expired or been withdrawn. Ask {sender} for a new link.
unavailable.bodyAnonymous: It may have been used, have expired or been withdrawn. Ask whoever sent it to you for a new link.

missing.title: This address is not a complete link
missing.body: Open the link from your email again, or copy all of it into the browser.
missing.bodyAnonymous: Open the link from your email again, or copy all of it into the browser.

error.title: The link cannot be opened right now
error.body: Our service did not answer. Try again in a few minutes.
error.bodyAnonymous: Our service did not answer. Try again in a few minutes.

pending.title: Not published here yet
pending.body: {sender} has not published its privacy notice on this page yet. Ask them for it: you have the right to receive it.
pending.bodyAnonymous: This company has not published its privacy notice on this page yet. Ask the company that sent you here for it: you have the right to receive it.

pdf.error: This document could not be opened.
pdf.pageError: This page could not be drawn.
pdf.previewUnavailable: The page preview is not available on this device. Download the document to read it.
pdf.nativeView: The page preview is not available here, so your browser shows the document with its own viewer.

forbidden.title: You cannot work in this company
forbidden.body: The address names a company your roles do not reach. Ask an administrator if you need it.

api.title: Nexus Factory is not answering
api.body: The service did not answer as it should (code {code}). Try again in a moment.

signInPlaceholder.title: Sign-in
signInPlaceholder.body: The office sign-in page arrives with the next build step. Your session has ended or you have not signed in yet.
